summary: Ermenegildo Zegna N.V. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 8, 2026, announcing that it will report third-quarter 2026 unaudited revenues on Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 6:30 a.m. ET (12:30 p.m. CET), followed by a conference call at 8:00 a.m. ET (2:00 p.m. CET) with a live webcast. The release provides dial-in details and notes the press release, presentation, and twelve-month replay will be available on the investor relations website. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed.
